Sesame Peanut Noodles

Synthetic post. A few reasons I love these:

  • Ready in 15 minutes
  • Pantry staples
Advertisement

Ingredients

For the sauce:

  • 3 Tbsp. creamy peanut butter
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 1 tsp. chili crisp (or to taste)
  • 2-3 tbsp warm water

For the noodles:

  • 8 oz. dried noodles
  • 1 cucumber, cut into matchsticks
  • 2 scallions, sliced

Instructions

  1. Whisk the sauce.
  2. Cook the noodles and toss.

Enjoy!
